summary: Iteration-2 features tested end-to-end. Backend: 41/41 pytest passing (28 regression + 13 new for Meetups, Comments, Reminders, Year 2 Path). Verified: POST /api/meetups host auto-RSVPs; GET /api/meetups upcoming-only + ?lat=&lng= distance sort with populated distance_km; GET /api/meetups/{id} returns attendee_list; POST rsvp 400 when waiver_accepted=false and 200 when true; DELETE rsvp toggles is_rsvped=False; DELETE meetup host-only (404 for non-host); GET /api/logs/{id} returns log+comments; private log returns 403 for non-owner and 200 for owner; POST /api/logs/{id}/comments works; DELETE /api/comments/{id} author-only (404 for non-author); feed & log detail carry comment_count; PATCH /api/profile/reminder persists {enabled,hour,minute} and is reflected in public_user via /api/auth/me and /profile/reminder response; GET /api/path/stages returns 7 stages across years 1 & 2 (orders 1-7), Year-2 (5-7) locked until Year 1 complete (seeker still gets 5-7 locked); GET /api/path/stages/5 returns Year-2 practices (meridian-qigong, deep-body-awareness). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, in-app navigation): logged in as seeker; home Path dashboard now shows '0/7 Stages' and renders all 7 stage cards (stage-card-1..7) including YEAR 2 (Meridian Activation, Dantian, Three Treasures visible in DOM); Community 'Meetups' segment renders with 'Host a circle' + 'Near me' buttons and an existing seeded meetup card; meetup/new creation flow (title, description, tradition chip, location/city, day chip, hour chip) navigated to /meetup/{id} detail screen showing 'Hosted by River Seeker (you)', '1 going' (host auto-RSVP), and host-only 'Cancel this circle' button; log/[id] screen exposes comment-input, comment-send, and comment-delete-* testIDs; settings screen exposes reminder-toggle + reminder-time-* chips. Deprecated packages detected: none new in this iteration. Known pointerEvents deprecation warning persists (from a transitive dep). Direct-URL reload of gated tabs still 401s briefly during AuthContext hydration (pre-existing behaviour from iteration_1); in-app tab navigation works cleanly.

integration_issues.flow: Direct URL page.goto to /community or /settings after login
integration_issues.issue: Pre-existing AuthContext hydration race (called out in iteration_1). On full document reload of a gated route, apiFetch fires before the session token is restored, producing a red-screen 'Not authenticated' overlay in dev. In-app tab navigation (recommended path for users) works correctly. No new regression introduced by this iteration.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warning still emitted at app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a dependency; not introduced by this iteration.

action_items: (Optional / carry-over from iteration_1) Harden AuthContext hydration so full-reload of gated routes waits for the token restore before firing API calls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1027 lines (grew from 789 with meetups/comments/reminders). Splitting into routers (auth, path, logs, meetups, community) is increasingly warranted.
haversine_km + `import math` are declared inline near the meetups routes; move imports to top and helpers to a utils module for clarity.

meetup_card() is called sequentially in list_meetups (up to 200 docs each triggering a users lookup + rsvps count). Consider batching author lookups and $lookup/aggregation for attendees to avoid N+1 as the meetups collection grows.

Meetup starts_at is stored as an ISO STRING and compared with $gte to now_utc().isoformat(); this works only because both are ISO-8601 in the same TZ format. Storing as a real datetime is safer and index-friendly.
